title: spiranthes swartzii
intro: Spiranthes swartzii, commonly known as the Zebra Orchid, is a species of flowering plant in the family Orchidaceae. It is a terrestrial orchid that has been used in traditional medicine for its various health benefits. The plant has been reported to have anti-inflammatory, antimicrobial, and antiviral properties, making it useful for treating conditions such as wounds, fever, and respiratory infections. The bioactive constituents of Spiranthes swartzii include flavonoids, alkaloids, and saponins, which are responsible for its therapeutic actions.
